entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.8 to 30.24.0.9 (fork commit `6084c07075ac`). It adds BigQuery, Snowflake and Synapse table layouts to `translate_ddl`, the `reduce_list_aggregates`, `nullif_zero_divisors`, `inline_order_by_aliases`, `alias_qualified_projections`, `qualify_alias_shadowed_columns`, `decimal_division_to_double` and `use_nulls_for_rollups` rewrites to the `apply_rewrite` registry, and keeps temporary table names unqualified. BenchBox does not call the new rewrites or pass layouts to those three platforms yet: the 23,667 translations of the 1,127 frozen shipped queries across 21 target dialects, the 2,600 golden-corpus runtime outputs and `make sql-execution-gate` are unchanged from 30.24.0.8, so no published result changes.
